notes: THE BUILDING TIER'S MATERIALS JOB (design docs/reports/building-tier-2026-10-23.md section 3, r7.1 approved by both engines; OWNER 10-23: Q1-Q11 as recommended, Q3 charcoal from surplus logs for torches only, the BUILD_RESERVE table logs 512 / copper ingots 512 / cobblestone 256 / torches 32 / sand 16 / planks 71 / sticks 40 (reserve-proposal-2026-10-23.md), matset-01 rolled out first). THE CHANGE: make_material, a deterministic HOUSEKEEPING town order (never the model's; never a trip; off in isolated pools, TP D2; MATS=0 off), consulted after every other order but planting and only when no rung is ready: one part kind per order -- 12 stone_bricks (12 cobblestone, the bag's spare first, smelted on EXACTLY 8 planks from 2 logs), 16 glass_pane (6 sand on 4 planks), 4 cut_copper (36 ingots), 3 copper_door (6 ingots), 24 torches (6 logs to charcoal on 4 planks + 8 sticks from 1 log; the job's own charcoal only) -- from TOWN STOCK ABOVE THE RESERVE (the town index: known, fresh containers; below 80% coverage the order counts the never-opened containers first), to the BUFFERS (stone_bricks 128, glass_pane 32, cut_copper 24, copper_door 3, torch 64), in a COLD furnace that qualifies (lit=false by the block state; input and fuel empty; output empty or the job's own -- anything else is furnace_drain's), leased (fail closed), one maker per town (a materials lease), one order per bot per 10 min, 10 min of town-job body time per bot-hour. A carry note (fsynced) before anything moves; parts and unspent inputs banked at the end (each name's opening count held for its deposit); mats_return reconciles an interrupted order at the next town visit (drains the note's furnace, crafts stone in fours, keeps a 1-3 remainder under the note). Fuel is planks only: coal, charcoal, iron, tools and the kit are never inputs (code); the row books the bag's forbidden names before and after. __EXTRA__

require.name: town jobs (bots at town with a working town smelt job: shared towns, furnaces in town)

draw_exposure.note: Shared towns only (the job is off in isolated pools, which write no smelt_town and are never drawn by this). The town index 10-23 ~21:50Z: cobblestone 674-1000 and oak logs 482-1475 (hive-d 67) known in every shared town, index coverage 0.73-0.94 of the census containers (hive-b 0.73: its first order counts), stone_bricks 0 everywhere -- every shared town but hive-b and hive-d (logs 217 and 67, under the 512 reserve) holds a bricks batch above the reserve; all 12 hold a cut_copper batch above the 512 ingot reserve (435-1886).

exposure.note: Design 6.1: >= 20 parts made by canary rows with verdict=ok (exact conservation by family, fuel booked by name) AND the WORLD: the parts' stock change over the canary pools' town containers known at both ends (the town index: what the server sent at each open) > 0, AND the instrument (control rung rows >= 1, control pools with index records >= 1). Expected: 4 pools x 5 bots at town, one bricks order (12 parts) per bot per 10 min at most, so 20 parts by +180 needs two orders.

own_lines.note: G1 (design 6.1 'any forbidden input consumed, coal burned included'): a canary _make_material row with verdict=forbidden -- the bag held fewer of an iron-ladder name (coal, charcoal, iron), a tool or a kit name after the order than before. ANY.

G2: rows with verdict=loss (a family short: cobble/stone/bricks, sand/glass/panes, copper, wood or torches left the boundary unaccounted), at least 2 AND > 5% of the reconciled rows; aborted rows are interruptions (mats_return's).

G3 (design 6.1 'the reserve crossed (index)'): a row whose OWN reading of the town (stock=, index-known: the index only under-counts) less what it took of an input is below that input's reserve (the licence row's reserve=). ANY.

G4 (design 6.1 'a stone count in a bag that rose across an order with no open note'): a bricks row whose bag stone rose (stone=b0>b1) with its note closed. ANY. A kept 1-3 remainder is under note=keep.
G5: two canary bots' make_material runs overlapping in one pool (the materials lease broken), or two bots' furnace sessions by=make_material overlapping on one furnace. ANY.
G6: a canary bot with > 7 make_material rows in any 60 min (the 10 min cooldown broken).
ARMS: a control _mats_mode or _make_material row after the deploy. BLOCKS KEEP.
LIVENESS: canary licence >= 1 and canary _make_material rows >= 1. BLOCKS KEEP (INCONCLUSIVE).

POSITIVE CONTROL: control rung rows >= 1 and control pools with town-index records >= 1. BLOCKS KEEP. Dry run 10-23 21:52Z (hive-a,board-c, 180 min, base build): 844 control rung rows, 10 control pools with index records.

primary.note: REPORTED: parts made by verdict=ok rows (by kind) WITH the WORLD -- the town index's parts stock change, canary vs control per-pool means over paired pools (control ~0 by construction: the base makes no stone bricks, panes, cut copper or doors; torches are excluded from the world sum). Dry run on the base: canary +0.0, control +0.0, DiD +0.0.

harm.note: Unchanged: the two-death floor and gather_ratio < 0.43 of control (immobiledid). No-harm DiD reported by the read (design 6.1): rung completions per bot-h, gather successes per bot-h, the smelt furnace_busy share, bag fill (occupied slots). Dry run on the base: rungs +0.497, gather -1.028 per bot-h DiD with no change (the noise band), furnace_busy +0.000, bag fill +0.38.

teardown.note: THREE STEPS: drop-ins, clear canary_pool, restart the pool's bots 12 s apart; then confirm the live versions. World changes: town cobble, logs, sand and copper ingots turned into building parts in town chests (kept; protected and always banked since matset-01). An open carry note on a reverted bot is harmless: the base never reads it (mats-carry-<bot>.json in the pool's state directory; delete at teardown). Rollback without a canary: MATS=0.
